about_the_game:
Delve into the world of ReSetna like never before! This digital artbook offers an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at the creative journey behind the game. Featuring stunning concept art, detailed character designs, and breathtaking environments, this collection is a must-have for fans of the game and lovers of sci-fi aesthetics.

  • Project Ascendance: Explore the origins and design process of the game’s unique world.

  • Synaptica: An advanced neural chip designed to store and transfer human consciousness.

  • ReSetna: Discover exclusive character art and early sketches of the protagonist.

  • NPCs: Encounter the inhabitants of Synaptica, from steadfast allies to enigmatic wanderers shaping ReSetna’s journey.

  • Bosses: Witness the evolution of ReSetna’s most formidable foes.

  • Enemies: Learn about the design process behind the deadly AI-driven adversaries.

  • Locations: From the Ruins of Polis_13 and the corrosive depths of Acidia to APEX’s secret stronghold, LAX, journey through the breathtaking yet haunting landscapes of ReSetna.

  • Props & Artifacts:  Concept designs for weapons, tools, and objects scattered throughout the game.

  • Wallpapers: A collection of high-resolution artwork to use as wallpapers or screensavers.

Unlock the secrets of ReSetna’s mech world, one page at a time.
